cards.note:
npm package with dsh.bundle.patch; installed via `dsh plugin --profile

add` and composed as a profile bundle layer (verified with --dump-config and a live boot on dsh 0.1.2-alpha.2).
manifest already declares dsh.client; no legacy dshClient field and no dsh.plugin.json in the tree.
dsh.client (platform web + ./client export) declared; the alpha.2 host composed the entry and served the client artifact.
every consumed service is declared: client inject ['locale'] for ctx.locale, host inject [].
no optional host-service probe; locale is a hard inject requirement of the client half.
no session/event subscription; the client half only touches ctx.locale.
no ctx.sessions use; the plugin renders no session UI.
no task/run output tailing and no tasks.peek call site.
no httpServer/tasks/onTaskDone usage anywhere in the host or client half.
no ImageAttachmentRef, read_image, or image metadata handling.
does not register, wrap, parse, or snapshot read_image.
no LLM adapter, image interceptor, or attachment cache.
no Host APIProxy or ctx.remote call sites.
target is alpha.2 and the plugin produces no persisted SessionEvents.
no host source patches or internal session-view imports.
uses the official bundle/profile path; nothing reads profile files or hardcodes DSH_HOME.
no headless wrapper or stdout/stderr parser.
no PTC/Code Mode vocabulary, presets, or dispatch waterfall use.
no WebFetch policy, approval, or audit surface.
registers no webServer route, WS/RPC channel, or custom /api path.
not a model-provider plugin; no settings-page patch or login UI workaround.

languages/dictionaries now ride ctx.locale.addLanguage + register(ns, locale, dict); the LocaleRuntime lookup patch, custom settings.general.item row, localStorage key, and betterLocale service are retired because the release ships the same slot/setting/API.
no subagent orchestration or selector surface.
makes no LLM request; package-name reporting is a deployment concern only.
no PowerShell, persistent-shell, or directory-picker workaround.
does not enable session-log-deepseek or upload session logs.

acceptance opens the full token URL from DSH_MIGRATE_WEB_URL and reads window.__DSH_BOOT__.entries; the package-name entry and its advertised combo artifact were additionally verified against a live 0.1.2-alpha.2 host.
no userQuestions provider registration.
does not resolve agent presets from persisted sessions.
no llm/message imports and no TPS or first-token detection.
insert-only bundle layer; it does not restate dsh-base telemetry or plugin-inventory rows.
no direct @earendil-works/pi-ai dependency.
dsh-client-runtime removed from peers and dsh.client.inject; the migrated client half consumes only the locale package.
bundle registration id, assembly row name, and package name all equal @bench/dsh-bench-locale-pack; confirmed in the live boot manifest and the served combo artifact.
reads no session timeline or user message content.
no composer DOM access, draft injection, or selection handling.
renders no MarkdownText or fenced CodeBlock from ui-primitives.
no ctx.connection.api / history / transcript reads.
does not construct or assert subagent descriptors.
no workspace navigation or directory-picker calls.
produces no third-party persisted SessionEvents.
no ctx.remote unary calls or Remote failure handling.

peers trimmed to @deepseek-ai/cordis ^4.0.1 and @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale ^0.1.2-alpha.2 (both optional); react, ui-primitives, ui-settings, ui-slots, and dsh-invariants peers removed with the retired row component.
no Node 22 pin or dsh web skip; nothing bypasses the Node 24.0-24.11.1 defect window.
does not consume pluginInventory/list or validate PluginInventorySnapshot.
no host.describe or ctx.remote.$host reads.
client-only plugin; it mounts none of the listed host tool packages and composes over the shipped bundle.
registers no settings namespace; locale.preference is owned and written by the locale service.
